name: guards
description: Denies Bash commands that change more than the agent knows about, each with the narrower command to run instead: git add -A / --all / ., git commit -a, chezmoi apply --force without a target, and killing a process by name. On Windows a command with a doubled backslash runs from a file so the Bash tool cannot halve it. The rules are named up front at session and subagent start.
